Class MetroScore

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model.MetroScore
public class MetroScore extends Object
Composite score for a metro recommendation, decomposed into individually inspectable ScoreComponent dimensions.

All scores — the composite and every per-category component — are on a 0–100 scale, higher is better. The composite is the sum of each component's score multiplied by its normalized weight.

  • Method Details

    • scoreFor

      public double scoreFor(ScoreCategory category)
      The 0–100 score for one category.

      Absent-category caveat: a category with no component returns 0.0, which is indistinguishable from a genuine zero score. Engine-produced scores always carry all five ScoreCategory components, so the ambiguity only arises on hand-built instances.

      Parameters:
      category - the dimension to read
      Returns:
      the category's score, or 0.0 when no such component exists
